slides.title: Why are Ethiopian outlets losing their licences?

slides.text: On **Nov 2**, the Ethiopian Media Authority said it was **indefinitely suspending The Reporter**, one of the country's oldest independent newspapers.
The authority says the paper published **“distorted information”** against **national interests**; CPJ says it **cited no specific report**.
CPJ says the regulator also revoked authorization for **Addis Standard** and **Wazema Radio** this year; **Human Rights Watch** calls it **“the new normal.”**
**Protect press freedom, allow independent review.** Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.
